queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" "misconfiguration" outage failure
queries.rationale: Directly locate empirical and reported incidents, studies, or experiments where LLMs produced incorrect/unsafe network configurations or caused operational failures (phenomenon).
Capture mechanisms of hallucination and incorrect code/tool-use that could explain how LLMs produce unsafe NetOps outputs (mechanisms).
Find prior architectures that interleave generation, automated validation, and repair—central mitigations for NetOps automation.

queries.query: network configuration verification Batfish NetPlumber Anteater 'formal verification' 'network' 'config'
queries.rationale: Locate deterministic/network verification tools and formal-methods literature used as validators or oracles for configurations (benchmarking/mitigation tooling).
Position LLM-driven config generation relative to intent-based networking and intent-to-configuration synthesis (neighboring work & problem framing).
Survey existing AIOps/NetOps benchmarks and datasets to assess ecological validity for LLM-driven NetOps evaluation (benchmark validity).

queries.query: agentic AI agent frameworks LangChain AutoGPT 'tool use' 'network' 'orchestration' safety
queries.rationale: Identify agentic orchestration frameworks used to build multi-tool LLM agents and their safety/guarding patterns relevant to NetOps agents (mechanisms/mitigations).
Search work on robustness and domain shift for models applied to network configuration distributions (mechanisms that cause failures).
Find techniques for constraining LLM outputs to syntactic/semantic schemas (mitigation: safe generation and schema enforcement).
Identify safe-execution environments and rollback/sandboxing practices for validating config changes before production application (mitigations & methods).
Locate studies and practices integrating operator oversight, approvals, and human checkpoints into automated NetOps workflows (mitigation/operational trust).
Find adversarial testing and red-teaming methodologies for exposing failure modes in agentic systems applied to operations (benchmark validity & failure analysis).

queries.query: benchmarks 'LLM' 'code generation' correctness 'network config' 'semantic correctness' evaluation metrics
queries.rationale: Survey evaluation metrics used for code and config generation and how they map to operational correctness in networks (methods & benchmark validity).

queries.query: NetKAT P4 'network semantics' 'formal model' 'config synthesis' 'program synthesis' 'verification'
queries.rationale: Collect literature on formal network semantics/languages that can serve as strong oracles or intermediate representations for LLM-based synthesis/validation (neighboring methods).

queries.query: program synthesis 'network configuration' 'correctness' 'synthesis from spec' 'SMT' 'SAT' 'constraint solving'
queries.rationale: Identify program synthesis and constraint-solving approaches for converting specs/intent to correct configurations that can complement LLMs (mechanisms & mitigations).

queries.query: trust explainability operator acceptance 'AI' 'NetOps' 'human factors' 'explainable AI' 'situational awareness'
queries.rationale: Find HCI and trust literature about operator acceptance, explainability, and transparency requirements for automated NetOps systems (neighboring work & mitigations).
Locate meta-analyses and critiques of LLM benchmarks and ecological validity to guide benchmark-design decisions for NetOps experiments (benchmark validity).

queries.query: case studies 'automation failure' 'network outage' 'misconfiguration' 'root cause analysis' 'human error' 'automation'
queries.rationale: Collect real-world case studies of outages caused by automation or misconfiguration to ground threat models and failure modes in operational reality (phenomenon & failure analysis).

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources: peer-reviewed conference/journal papers, arXiv/tech-report preprints, verified project repositories and tool documentation, publicly available benchmarks/datasets, and standards (IETF drafts RFCs) relevant to NetOps.
Works that present empirical results, reproducible artifacts, formal methods, benchmarks, or well-documented incident/case studies.
Publications from ~2000–2026 for foundational verification and networking work; priority to 2018–2026 for LLM/agentic material and recent AIOps work.
English-language works or those with verifiable metadata and accessible primary content.
exclusion_criteria: Unofficial blog posts, short tweets, or social-media claims used as sole evidence unless they link to verifiable primary artifacts (exclude uncorroborated social posts).
Proprietary internal reports or confidential incident summaries not publicly accessible.
Works that do not engage operational NetOps, network configuration, verification, or automation (e.g., purely conversational LLM benchmarks with no operational mapping).
Duplicative secondary summaries without primary-source links (use primary papers when possible).
date_rationale: LLM and agentic-AI developments accelerated since 2021, so prioritize literature from 2018–2026 for model/agent-specific methods and 2021–2026 for agentic evaluations; nevertheless include foundational network verification and formal-methods literature (circa 2000 onward) because those tools and semantics remain essential validators and mitigations. Ensure the search captures the latest 2024–2026 preprints and tool releases to reflect current capabilities and risks.
